title: UI feedback receipt, visual evidence and first concrete contracts
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: partial actual audit review; source attribution, visual-test validity and existing-versus-proposed UI distinguished
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual content review covers original1–325 only: input/routes, UF1–UF7/new-feature table, visual-source follow-up/VF1–VF5, MC1–MC24 and their concrete specifications, round3 opening/MC25 and MC26 start. Dense UF4 and check-boundary truncations were recovered before credit. Original326–1174 remains. This reads the audit text and exact evidence qualifications, not a new visual inspection of attached images, source/test execution, chat transcript search or current UI replay.

F2: Preserve human-source boundaries. Selected original-message retrieval is attributed to the audit, with exact session/line locators. No recovered exact older cramped quote does not negate the user's current named concern, and the audit's observed particular collision must not be attributed to the user. Requested fewer generic/circular/web/text-heavy forms is not a universal shape ban. Gallery alternatives, later blue/blockier preference and actual selected design stay distinct. Historical56/58% quotas, coordinator queues and live source/worker claims grant no current budget, worker or new UI lane.

F3: Distinguish native fresh route, seeded homeowner/fight, synthetic gallery, static source and installed app. UF1 proves one coupled adjustable seam, not arbitrary independent resizing. UF2 preserves selection while focus falls elsewhere; UF7's extra34px page height does not prove unreachable controls or its cause. VF1 requested21px was still12px labels and is not a valid independent large-text case; VF4 actual rendered SVG14→16px differs from parent14→21px. Zero overlap/page errors does not establish readability, accessibility, comprehension or preference. No current visual defect is reproduced by reading this report.

F4: UF4/VF5 actual herb success/failure on different lots is not outcome parity. Keep selected identity/order/quantity, real immediate or held time, spend-on-failure, readiness, abandonment/refund and collection policies distinct. Unknown viability need not stop an effective unidentified material; preview/renderer cannot grant a result. Nearby clerk presence is not actual available service; route existing proposal/status or bind an authorized command without inventing a transaction. Real social topic, belief, received answer, relationship verdict and mere ask request differ. Equipment compare already distinguishes structured wearer/body/context; loadout per-slot partial result is not atomic whole-set equip.

F5: MC20's later concrete correction supersedes its earlier assumed missing continuation backend: controls exist in the inspected source, with current browser proof separate. Actual resume, rewind, fresh start and baggage carry have distinct state/history consequences; world-fact anchor derivation is another mechanism. The old L2b below-floor ordering and old empty-opening/world-census labels require later exact receipts/current PROJECT before reopening. Present unknown/unwired/unchecked versus genuinely absent producer precisely. Six basic world questions, optional inspectors and form comparison do not require every world/system before fixing one quote or return.

F6: MC1–MC24 preserve domain identity, actual quote and observer projection across list/graph/search/accessible labels, explicit body/clock/recipient/subject, stable return/focus and distinct game/preference/transient state. Unknown counts/edges can leak truth; deleting a caption is insufficient. Dense task can use a grid/list/diagram when it serves real decisions, not mandate one form or duplicate authority. AD51 qualifies old two-consumer extraction prerequisites; current AD36/AD42/AD43 and UI owners scope proof. No runtime, browser, image-preview, private save, source acquisition, worker, migration, deletion, stage/commit or push occurred.
reviews.evidence: Actual original1–325 read sequentially with UF4 and Check-boundaries truncation recovered. Underlying screenshots/transcripts/code not reopened.
reviews.reopen: Continue original326–1174 and appended notes; combine actual ranges and unchanged original identity before full credit.
